thread:
elaine_cs: Quick heads-up — SolarWind (onboarding) is seeing p95 tail latency regressions since they ramped traffic yesterday. Renewal check-in is next Wed and CS flagged this as a risk.

arjun_se: Can you paste the p95/p99 numbers? also which model and route are they on?

elaine_cs: p50 ~120ms, p95 went from 420ms -> 760ms, p99 ~1.2s. They’re on rw-curie-2024 (hosted) on default routing. Traffic pattern: lots of short prompts + bursty batch of long contexts.

diana_ml: Ok. Likely KV cache churn + small batch tails. Quick low-risk plan: 1) propose an immediate route change to Dedicated-small for their highest QPS endpoints, 2) swap to a quantized variant (rw-curie-2024-int8) for cost parity, 3) enable prefix caching for repeated prompts.

elaine_cs: I drafted a concise recommendation for their CSM and AE — want to run it by you before sharing.

arjun_se: SGTM. Add a canary: route 10% of traffic to the dedicated pool + quant model for 1 hour and measure p95. If stable, promote to 50% then full. We should include automatic fallback to hosted baseline if errors spike.

diana_ml: Agree. Also suggest a short token-level sampling eval to ensure no regression in completions for their top 20 prompts. We can run diff-check on 200 examples and report quality delta.

sara_solarwind: thanks — appreciate the proactive note. Can we get the canary today? Our launch is Monday and we'd rather avoid surprises. Also want a short summary for our execs.

elaine_cs: @sara_solarwind we can do canary today. Plan: 1) 10% traffic -> dedicated-small w/ rw-curie-2024-int8, 2) 30m health monitor for latency/errors, 3) run qa-diff (200 samples) for quality check, 4) prepare rollback script. ETA 2-3 hours.

perfbot: Canary job queued: job_id=cb-2002-81, expected run 10m. alerts will fire on error_rate>1% or p95>600ms.

arjun_se: Rollback snippet for ops:
```bash
# rollback to hosted baseline
redwood route update --customer solarwind --route main --target hosted --model rw-curie-2024
```

diana_ml: Note for CS collateral: include the quality delta table and the canary timeline + cost impact estimate. Quick estimate: int8 should reduce token cost ~22% and reduce GPU memory allowing dedicated-small to handle bursts.

elaine_cs: I'll send the recommendation + invite a 15m sync with SolarWind (CS, AE, Ops) after the canary. Also flagging renewal risk in CRM as "At-Risk: latency" and noting the mitigation attempt.

deploy-bot: Canary job cb-2002-81 started (canary=10%, route=dedicated-small, model=rw-curie-2024-int8). Monitoring p50/p95/p99 every 60s.

elaine_cs: Thanks all — I'll capture SolarWind feedback in the followup (we'll log any quality concerns and next steps). Will update thread when canary completes. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary job cb-2002-81 completed. results: p95=420ms, p99=680ms, error_rate=0.2%. Quality diff: BLEU-like metric change <0.6% on sampled prompts.

elaine_cs: Great result. I'll send the exec summary and recommended rollout steps to SolarWind and mark CRM as "Mitigated - ongoing monitoring".

sara_solarwind: incredible — thanks to the team for the quick turnaround. We'll loop in product for any longer-term prompt pattern changes.

arjun_se: Moving to 50% for 2 hrs then full if stable. I'll open a short follow-up thread for cost projections.

diana_ml: Captured action item: run weekly quality sampling for 2 weeks and watch for drift.

elaine_cs: Closing note: captured all feedback in the enablement doc and scheduled a renewal prep call for next Tue.
